svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.fern-alternation-of-generations-model", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One introduced representative homosporous fern alternation-of-generations lesson, distinguishing diploid sporophyte from haploid spore/gametophyte and the meiosis versus fertilisation transitions. Restricted representative homosporous fern model, not every fern taxon, heterosporous aquatic fern, apogamous reproduction, microscopic organ anatomy, exact source725 worksheet or measured life history. Heart-shaped gametophytes are selected here, not universal across all fern species. Sex organs, gametes, zygote and tissue junction are aggregated in the introduced fertilisation link rather than silently omitted from the biology. No eggs, spores, seeds and sorus clusters treated as synonyms; no energy-cycle claim. Phase badges and process identities require explicit external teaching/audio key; physical recognition untested.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard.
